'''Assimara Sheep''' are the [[:Category:Assimara_Parasites|Assimara Version]] of Sheep.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns individually, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 4|Phase 4]] onward, with a spawnweight of 1, once 3 Sheep have been assimilated.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimara Sheep are Heavy Backline Ranged units.

* Assimara Sheep fire a Nade every 5 seconds, a projectile that creates a block of acid upon contact, inflicting very high damage per second, and ignores immunity frames. Cooldown decreases after reaching 50% of its health.
* Assimara Sheep are incapable of melee attack.
* Assimara Sheep will attempt to maintain a certain distance from their enemies to avoid melee.
* Assimara Sheep are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimara Sheep are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimara Sheep will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* On death Assimara Sheep have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimara Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and COTH.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Assimara Sheep, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
